body.en: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pressure-gradient-diagrams-d_647.html HBT8018 Concrete Pump outlet pressure versus output How HBT8018 Concrete Pump Separates Pressure from Output Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the HBT8018 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 60 m³/h and Pumping Pressure 40 MPa. Output is a volume rate. Pressure is a sep Pressure is a separate cell on the same sheet. That frame does not list these two cells, and another maker's plate is not copied onto this model. The two cells stay apart On the HBT8018 Concrete Pump sheet, Theoretical Output is 60 m³/h and Pumping Pressure is 40 MPa. A piston pump pushes concrete into the line; a squeeze pump flattens a hose from outside. Either way, m³/h is not MPa. Max. Aggregate Size 4 cm and below. Delivery Pipe Diameter 100 / 125 mm. Total Weight 6500 kg. What the frame is allowed to show Its subject is Jet pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not treat that caption as a nameplate for the HBT8018 Concrete Pump. Stroke length, cycle rate and price are absent from both the caption and this catalogue row. Blanks that stay blank The Xingtai row does not list a service interval, a seal torque, an export destination or a job case. Those listed extras are still not a stroke length. What output does the HBT8018 Concrete Pump sheet list? Theoretical Output is 60 m³/h. What pressure cell is on the same sheet? Pumping Pressure is 40 MPa. The figures are catalogue cells. Is a piston stroke listed? No. The sheet leaves stroke length, cycle rate and price unprinted. Hebei Pinjin Machinery, Xingtai, Hebei, China Jet pump. Subject of the frame for the HBT8018 Concrete Pump catalogue note, Hebei Pinjin Machinery, Xingtai, Hebei
